definitions.gloss: examination admission ticket; exam entry pass
definitions.explanation: A document that a test-taker must bring to be admitted to an examination. It typically includes the candidate's name, photo, exam number, and venue information.

examples.japanese: {受験票|じゅけんひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れないで→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please don't forget your exam admission ticket.

examples.japanese: {受験票|じゅけんひょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦いよいよ→いよいよ：06353_iyoiyo⟧⟦{本番|ほんばん}→本番：19392_honban⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{実感|じっかん}→実感：04213_jikkan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My exam ticket arrived, and it finally felt real that the exam was approaching.

examples.japanese: ⟦{当日|とうじつ}→当日：04558_toujitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{受験票|じゅけんひょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{写真付|しゃしんつ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{身分証明書|みぶんしょうめいしょ}→身分証明書：09809_mibunshoumeisho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持参|じさん}して→持参する：21143_jisansuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: On the day, please bring your exam admission ticket and a photo ID.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{受験|じゅけん}→受験：04272_juken⟧ (taking an exam) + ⟦{票|ひょう}→票：03582_hyou⟧ (slip, ticket, ballot). An essential document for anyone sitting a formal examination in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {受験票|じゅけんひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持参|じさん}する→持参する：21143_jisansuru⟧ (to bring one's exam ticket)
- {受験票|じゅけんひょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧ (for the exam ticket to arrive)
- {受験票|じゅけんひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{印刷|いんさつ}する→印刷する：21677_insatsusuru⟧ (to print one's exam ticket)
- {受験票|じゅけんひょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{紛失|ふんしつ}する→紛失する：18835_funshitsusuru⟧ (to lose one's exam ticket)
- {受験票|じゅけんひょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貼|は}る→貼る：10447_haru⟧ (to affix a photo to one's exam ticket)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {受験番号|じゅけんばんごう} — exam number; the unique identification number printed on the ticket
- ⟦{入場券|にゅうじょうけん}→入場券：19454_nyuujouken⟧ — admission ticket; for general entry to venues, not exams

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, forgetting one's {受験票|じゅけんひょう} on exam day is a well-known source of panic. During major exam seasons (⟦{入試|にゅうし}→入試：04705_nyuushi⟧), news programs often feature stories of students who forgot their tickets and the efforts made to accommodate them.
